name: ZEE crankset
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed average 837 g for FC-M645, 175 mm crank arms and 34T chainrings, excluding the bottom bracket and chain/bash guard. The weight heading explicitly specifies 175 mm without BB; the selected model and chainring configuration are retained without converting to a 170 mm estimate. This is the 83 mm bottom-bracket-shell version, distinct from FC-M640.
